name: LegiSchool Civics Virtual Institute
org: Sacramento State Center for California Studies with the California State Legislature
what_you_do: You can take a four-week online summer program about California policy. It includes talks from state leaders and professional skills workshops, and you earn a stipend at the end.
who_can_apply: California high school sophomores, juniors and seniors. A select number are chosen.
pay_detail: Stipend paid after the program. The amount is not posted.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed May 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply through the LegiSchool website application. Join their mailing list for contest, town hall and internship news.
notes: Application link and 2027 dates are not on the page. The stipend amount is not stated. LegiSchool also runs Town Hall meetings in downtown Sacramento and video and essay contests for California high school students.
